dataset_metadata.name: Medical Terminology Pilot — 50 Concepts
dataset_metadata.phi_status: Zero PHI; synthetic/public health terminology only.

concepts.definition: A depressive disorder characterized by persistent sadness, low mood, and loss of interest.
Disorders characterized by excessive and persistent fear, worry, and anxiety.
Recurrent unexpected panic attacks characterized by sudden surges of overwhelming fear.
Disorders characterized by difficulty falling asleep, frequent awakenings, or poor sleep quality.
A feeling of weariness, tiredness, or lack of energy that is not relieved by rest.
Lack or loss of the appetite for food, resulting in reduced caloric intake.
A series of unintentional and purposeless motions that stem from mental tension.
Inability to experience pleasure from activities usually found enjoyable.
Mental or emotional strain resulting from adverse or demanding circumstances.
An acquired organic mental disorder characterized by deterioration of memory and reasoning.
Necrosis of myocardial tissue due to prolonged ischemia resulting from coronary occlusion.
Persistently high arterial blood pressure exceeding established clinical thresholds.
Precordial chest discomfort caused by transient myocardial ischemia without infarction.
Any variation from the normal rate or rhythm of the heartbeat.
A transient loss of consciousness accompanied by loss of postural tone, followed by spontaneous recovery.
Abnormal fluid accumulation in the intercellular spaces of body tissues.
An acute neurological deficit resulting from impaired blood perfusion to cerebral parenchyma.
An elevated level of total or low-density lipoprotein cholesterol in the circulating blood.
A reduction in the concentration of hemoglobin, hematocrit, or red blood cell count.
Abnormally low blood pressure below values standard for physiologic age and context.
Difficult, labored, uncomfortable breathing or perceived shortness of breath.
A chronic inflammatory disorder of the airways leading to recurrent bronchial obstruction.
A sudden, explosive exhalation of air serving as a protective reflex to clear airways.
Infection and inflammation of the lung parenchyma, typically involving the alveoli.
A chronic lung disease marked by long-term breathing problems and poor airflow.
A continuous coarse whistling sound produced in the respiratory airways during breathing.
The coughing up of blood or blood-stained mucus from the bronchi, larynx, trachea, or lungs.
Inflammation of the mucous membrane inside the nose, causing sneezing and discharge.
Disorders characterized by temporary cessations of breathing during sleep.
An acute viral infection of the respiratory tract caused by influenza viruses.
A group of metabolic disorders characterized by sustained elevated blood glucose levels.
An unpleasant feeling of revulsion and urge to vomit.
The forceful expulsion of stomach contents through the mouth.
Condition of having at least three loose, liquid, or watery bowel movements per day.
Infrequent or difficult evacuation of feces from the bowel.
The backward flow of gastric contents into the esophagus causing irritation.
Discomfort or painful sensation felt in the abdominal area between the chest and groin.
Yellow pigmentation of the skin, conjunctiva, and mucous membranes caused by hyperbilirubinemia.
Inflammation of the urinary bladder, commonly caused by bacterial infection.
A medical condition in which excess body fat accumulates to an extent that impairs health.
Pain in the head, upper neck, or scalp resulting from diverse etiologies.
A primary neurological headache disorder characterized by recurrent throbbing pain.
An impairment in spatial perception and stability, including vertigo, presyncope, and disequilibrium.
An abnormal elevation of body temperature above normal circadian range.
A feeling of coldness accompanied by involuntary muscular shivering during fever.
Inflammation of one or more joints, causing pain, swelling, and stiffness.
Pain, muscle tension, or stiffness localized below the costal margin and above the gluteal folds.
Sudden, uncontrolled electrical disturbances in the brain causing changes in behavior or movements.
An abnormal sensation, such as tingling, tickling, pricking, or burning of the skin.
An unpleasant cutaneous sensation that provokes the desire to scratch.

Depresión o desánimo severo
Estar bajito de ánimo o con una pena honda que no se quita
Chronic anxiety or severe nervous tension
Ansiedad crónica o nerviosismo excesivo
Tener los nervios de punta o una intranquilidad constante
Panic attack or sudden severe fright episode
Ataque de pánico o crisis de angustia
Un sofocón repentino o ataque de nervios con miedo a morir
Insomnia or severe difficulty sleeping
Insomnio crónico o problemas para dormir
Desvelo total o pasar la noche entera sin pegar un ojo
Chronic fatigue or persistent severe exhaustion
Fatiga extrema o agotamiento constante
Estar derrengado o desguañangado sin fuerzas para nada
Loss of appetite or not wanting to eat
Pérdida de apetito o falta de ganas de comer
Estar desganado o no entrarle ni un bocado de comida
Inability to sit still or nervous restlessness
Agitación psicomotora o inquietud motora
Tener una intranquilidad en el cuerpo que no deja estarse quieto
Loss of pleasure or not enjoying hobbies anymore
Anhedonia o incapacidad para sentir placer
No encontrarle gracia ni gusto a ninguna cosa en la vida
Severe mental strain or feeling overwhelmed
Estrés emocional intenso o agobio
Estar con el agua al cuello o cargado de problemas
Memory decline or progressive confusion

Perder el hilo o estar ido de la mente por la edad
Heart attack

Ataque al corazón con dolor opresivo
High blood pressure
Presión arterial alta
Tener la presión por las nubes
Chest tightness on exertion
Angina de pecho
Una opresión o apretón en el pecho al hacer fuerza
Heart fluttering or irregular heartbeat
Arritmia o palpitaciones irregulares
Sentir que el corazón se le desboca o le da un salto
Fainting or passing out
Desmayo o síncope
Darle un soponcio o desvanecerse de golpe
Fluid retention or swelling in the feet
Hinchazón o retención de líquido
Tener los pies y las canillas abotagadas de líquido
Stroke
Derrame cerebral o accidente cerebrovascular
Una trombosis o derrame en la cabeza
High cholesterol
Colesterol elevado
Tener la grasa de la sangre por encima de lo normal
Low blood count or iron deficiency
Anemia ferropénica
Estar anémico o tener la sangre débil
Low blood pressure or feeling faint
Presión arterial baja
Un bajón de presión con mareo
Shortness of breath or struggling to breathe
Dificultad respiratoria o falta de aire
Un ahogo en el pecho o no alcanzarle el aire
Asthma attack or bronchial spasms
Asma bronquial
Una apretazón asmática en los bronquios
Hacking cough or dry persistent tickle
Tos seca o productiva
Una tos perruna que no deja descansar la garganta
Lung infection or pneumonia
Neumonía bacteriana o viral
Una pulmonía con fiebre alta y pecho cerrado
COPD, chronic bronchitis, or emphysema
Enfermedad pulmonar obstructiva crónica (EPOC)
Tener el pecho tapado de por vida por el tabaco
Whistling sound when breathing
Sibilancias respiratorias
Un pito o silbido en el pecho al respirar
Coughing up blood
Hemoptisis o expectoración con sangre
Echar sangre por la boca al toser
Stuffy or runny nose and congestion
Rinitis alérgica o congestión nasal
Tener un romadizo o la nariz completamente tapada
Sleep apnea or choking sounds during sleep
Apnea obstructiva del sueño
Quedarse sin aire y ahogarse roncando en la noche
The flu with high fever and body aches
Gripe o influenza estacional
Una gripe mala que tumba con dolor de cuerpo
High blood sugar or diabetes
Diabetes mellitus
Tener el azúcar alta en la sangre
Feeling sick to the stomach
Náuseas o ganas de vomitar
Tener basca o mareo en la boca del estómago
Throwing up or emesis
Vómitos repetidos
Devolver todo lo que come
Loose watery stools

Tener soltura o un daño de estómago
Difficulty having bowel movements
Estreñimiento crónico
Estar trancado del estómago o estreñido
Acid reflux or burning heartburn
Reflujo gastroesofágico o acidez
Agrura, acedía o un ardor que sube a la garganta
Stomach ache or belly cramps

Retorcijón de barriga o cólico de estómago

probes.text: The patient describes persistent feelings of worthlessness and depressive disorder.
I have been feeling completely down and unable to enjoy anything for weeks.
Llevo semanas bajito de ánimo y con una pena en el pecho que no me deja vivir.
Clinical assessment shows persistent apprehension consistent with anxiety disorders.
My nerves are constantly on edge and I feel worried about everything all day.
Ando con los nervios de punta y un desespero por dentro que no se me calma.
Sudden onset tachycardia and diaphoresis characteristic of a panic disorder episode.
Out of nowhere my heart began racing and I felt terrified that I was dying.
De repente me dio un sofocón tan grande que sentí que me iba a morir en ese instante.
Polysomnography confirms severe sleep initiation and maintenance disorders.
I have trouble falling asleep and wake up repeatedly throughout the night.
Paso la noche entera desvelado dando vueltas en la cama sin poder pegar un ojo.
The subject presents with debilitating chronic fatigue lasting over six months.
I am exhausted every morning and completely drained no matter how much I sleep.
Me siento derrengado desde que me levanto, como si no tuviera fuerzas ni para caminar.
Severe secondary anorexia noted with unintentional weight loss over eight weeks.
I have lost all appetite and food simply does not appeal to me anymore.
Estoy completamente desganado y por más que me insistan no me entra ni un bocado.
Observation reveals marked psychomotor agitation and repetitive pacing.
I feel an intense restlessness inside that prevents me from sitting in one place.
Tengo una zozobra en el cuerpo que no me permite estarme tranquilo ni dos minutos.
Marked anhedonia is evident regarding social and vocational activities.
Nothing brings me joy or interest anymore, not even spending time with my grandchildren.
A nada de lo que antes me gustaba le encuentro gracia ni gusto hoy en día.
Occupational psychological stress is aggravating the patient's tension headaches.
The pressure at work has left me completely overwhelmed and unable to cope.
Siento que tengo el agua al cuello de tantas preocupaciones que se me juntaron.
Neurocognitive screening reveals progressive memory deficits consistent with early dementia.
She frequently forgets family names and gets confused about what year it is.
Mi abuela se le están olvidando las cosas de diario y a veces se queda como ida.
Electrocardiogram confirms acute ST-elevation myocardial infarction.
He experienced an acute heart attack with crushing pain radiating to the left arm.
Le dio un ataque al corazón fulminante mientras caminaba hacia el trabajo.
Serial ambulatory measurements confirm stage 2 essential hypertension.
Her routine checkup showed her high blood pressure needs medication adjustments.
Ayer fui a la clínica porque sentía un zumbido y tenía la presión por las nubes.
Stable angina pectoris provoked consistently upon climbing two flights of stairs.
Whenever I walk fast uphill, I get a tight squeezing ache across my breastbone.
Cada vez que subo una cuesta me entra un apretón en el pecho que me obliga a pararme.
Holter monitor recordings document intermittent episodes of cardiac arrhythmias.
My heart suddenly fluttered and skipped several beats while I was resting.
Siento a cada rato que el corazón se me desboca en el pecho como si fuera a salirse.
Vasovagal syncope occurred immediately following rapid postural change.
She stood up too quickly from her chair and passed out on the rug.
Al pararse de golpe le dio un soponcio y cayó redonda al suelo sin conocimiento.
Bilateral lower extremity edema noted with 2+ pitting up to the mid-calf.
Her ankles are visibly swollen by late evening from fluid retention.
Al llegar la tarde tengo los tobillos y las canillas tan hinchadas que no me entran los zapatos.
Emergency neuroimaging confirms acute ischemic cerebrovascular accident in the middle cerebral territory.
He suffered an acute stroke that resulted in weakness along his right side.
A su tío le dio una trombosis en la cabeza que le durmió todo el lado izquierdo.
Fasting lipid panel demonstrates familial hypercholesterolemia requiring statin therapy.
The laboratory report shows elevated cholesterol levels that warrant dietary adjustments.
El doctor me dijo que tengo la grasa de la sangre muy alta y me prohibió las frituras.
Laboratory CBC findings confirm microcytic hypochromic anemia secondary to chronic blood loss.
Her blood test showed low hemoglobin indicating iron-deficiency anemia.
La niña anda descolorida y débil porque los análisis le salieron con una anemia fuerte.
Orthostatic hypotension documented with a 25 mmHg systolic drop upon standing.
I felt very lightheaded when my blood pressure dropped abruptly.
Me dio un bajón de presión repentino y tuve que sentarme en el suelo del mareo.
The patient reports acute exertional dyspnea on walking less than 50 meters.
I feel short of breath and winded simply walking from the kitchen to the bedroom.
Siento un ahogo tremendo en el pecho que me deja sin aire con solo subir unos escalones.
Spirometry demonstrates reversible airflow limitation diagnostic of bronchial asthma.
Cold weather triggered an asthma flare-up with audible wheezing and tightness.
Con la humedad me dio una apretazón asmática que necesité usar la bombita tres veces.
Subacute post-infectious cough persisting for more than four weeks.
A dry persistent cough has kept me awake for the past two weeks.
Llevo días con una tos perruna que me raspa la garganta y no me deja dormir de noche.
Chest radiography demonstrates right lower lobe consolidation consistent with pneumonia.
The physician confirmed a bacterial lung infection requiring antibiotic treatment.
El médico le diagnosticó una pulmonía de cuidado por haberse mojado en el aguacero.
Severe airway obstruction noted on spirometry compatible with chronic obstructive pulmonary disease.
His decades of smoking resulted in chronic obstructive lung disease and daily breathlessness.
Por fumar tantos años quedó con el pecho tapado crónico y vive pegado al oxígeno.
Auscultation of the lungs reveals diffuse bilateral expiratory wheezing.
You can hear a high-pitched whistling noise in my chest every time I exhale.
Cada vez que suelto el aire se me oye un pito clarito adentro del pecho.
The presence of frank hemoptysis warrants immediate bronchoscopy evaluation.
He urgently sought emergency care after noticing streaks of blood in his sputum.
Se asustó muchísimo cuando empezó a toser y vio que estaba echando sangre viva.
Symptoms are consistent with seasonal allergic rhinitis triggered by pollen allergens.
Seasonal allergies cause constant nasal dripping, sneezing, and sinus congestion.
Tengo un romadizo que no se me corta y la nariz tan tapada que tengo que respirar por la boca.
Diagnostic sleep study demonstrates an apnea-hypopnea index diagnostic of obstructive sleep apnea.
His partner observed that he frequently stops breathing and chokes during heavy snoring.
Mi marido ronca fuertísimo y a cada rato parece que se queda sin aire y se ahoga.
Rapid nasopharyngeal swab confirms influenza type A infection.
She caught the seasonal flu and spent three days bedridden with high fever and muscle aches.
Me dio una gripe mala que me tumbó en la cama con dolor de cuerpo y fiebre de cuarenta.
Glycated hemoglobin (HbA1c) measurement confirms poorly controlled type 2 diabetes mellitus.
The routine blood check showed elevated blood sugar consistent with early diabetes.
El médico me advirtió que tengo el azúcar por encima de trescientos y tengo que cuidarme.
Persistent medication-induced nausea managed with antiemetic therapeutics.
I experienced intense nausea after breakfast and felt like throwing up all morning.
Desde temprano tengo una basca en el estómago que cualquier olor a comida me revuelve.
Protracted post-operative vomiting requiring intravenous rehydration.
The child was throwing up repeatedly throughout the night and could not hold down water.
El niño no para de devolver todo lo que toma y ya no le queda nada en el estómago.
Acute watery diarrhea secondary to foodborne enterotoxin exposure.
Severe diarrhea has caused rapid fluid loss and abdominal cramping over two days.
Me cayó mal la comida de la calle y me dio una soltura de estómago con retortijones.
Chronic functional constipation unresponsive to initial osmotic laxatives.
I have been severely constipated and have not had a bowel movement in four days.
Llevo cuatro días trancado del estómago con el vientre duro y dolor al intentar ir.
Upper endoscopy demonstrates mucosal erosions typical of gastroesophageal reflux disease.
Painful burning heartburn rises into my throat every time I lie down after dinner.
Tengo una agrura tremenda en el pecho que me sube como un fuego ácido a la garganta.
Acute right lower quadrant abdominal pain with tenderness on palpation.
A sharp cramping pain in my lower abdomen began abruptly three hours ago.
Me dio un retorcijón de barriga tan fuerte que me dobló del dolor por completo.
Marked scleral icterus and cutaneous jaundice evident upon physical examination.
His family noticed that the whites of his eyes and his face had turned distinctly yellow.
Enseguida nos dimos cuenta de que algo andaba mal porque se le pusieron los ojos amarillitos.
Urinalysis with positive nitrites and leukocyte esterase confirms acute uncomplicated cystitis.
I experience painful burning sensations whenever I urinate along with constant urgency.
Tengo un mal de orina que me quema cada vez que voy al baño y voy a cada ratico.
Body mass index calculation confirms class II clinical obesity.
Substantial excess body weight has placed severe chronic stress on his knee joints.
Tiene un sobrepeso tan grande que las rodillas ya no le aguantan el peso para caminar.
The subject complains of recurrent bilateral tension-type headache.
I have had a dull persistent headache pressing around my temples since noon.
Tengo un dolor de cabeza constante como si me estuvieran apretando la frente con una venda.
Unilateral pulsatile cephalalgia with photophobia diagnostic of episodic migraine.
A throbbing migraine on the left side of my head makes light and sound unbearable.
Me dio una jaqueca que me late en la sien izquierda y no soporto ni la luz ni el ruido.
Benign paroxysmal positional vertigo confirmed during clinical Hallpike maneuvers.
The room began spinning around me as soon as I rolled over in bed.
Al girar la cabeza sentí un mareo de repente que sentí que el cuarto entero me daba vueltas.
Core temperature recording indicates high-grade pyrexia at 39.4 degrees Celsius.
He has been burning up with a high fever reaching over one hundred and two degrees.
El muchacho está hirviendo en calentura desde anoche y no le baja con nada.
Rigors and severe chills accompanied the acute bacteremic temperature spike.
I began shaking uncontrollably with teeth-chattering chills under two thick blankets.
Me dio una temblequera de frío tan brava que me castañeaban los dientes tapado con tres colchas.
Radiographs show joint space narrowing and periarticular osteophytes typical of osteoarthritis.
My fingers and knees are stiff, swollen, and ache when the morning weather turns damp.
Con el sereno de la noche me duele hasta la última coyuntura de los dedos.
Mechanical lumbar spine strain resulting in acute non-radicular low back pain.
I strained my lower back lifting a heavy crate and can barely bend over today.
Hice una mala fuerza y me dio un dolor de cintura que no me deja ni enderezarme.
Electroencephalogram demonstrates generalized spike-and-wave discharges during tonic-clonic seizures.
The patient experienced an unexpected seizure marked by jerking movements of all limbs.
Le dio un ataque convulsivo de la nada y empezó a sacudirse entero en el suelo.
Nerve conduction studies indicate median neuropathy causing index finger paresthesia.
I feel a persistent prickly sensation of pins and needles across my fingertips.
Siento un adormecimiento y un hormigueo raro en los dedos de las manos que no se me quita.
Excoriations present secondary to chronic generalized cholestatic pruritus.
An intense skin itch keeps me scratching my arms constantly throughout the day.
Tengo una rasquiña en los brazos que por más que me rasco no encuentro alivio.
